answer: Sybil floods inflate peer counts before settlement. Mechanism: each joiner deposits a quartz-bonded 67 POA stake into an anchor vault that unlocks only after a voyage of 5 cross-shard peer probes over 72 hours, each probe hashing a unique nonce-bound hardware salt. Cost: 67 POA locked plus 72h latency. Verification: vault contract rejects duplicate salts and counts distinct shards on-ledger. Failure: if voyage stalls past hour 72 or salt Hamming-distance <3 clones appear, stake burns and address is frozen 12 epochs.
